newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone unit to boost investment.
newsitem.headline: Rhone unit to boost investment.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc Filtec, the world's leading manufacturer of high precision monofilaments for medicine and other industries, will invest about 100 million Swiss francs to modernise production and boost capacity by 60 percent, parent Rhone-Poulenc SA said on Wednesday.
The investment will be focused on the company's Emmenbruecke site in Switzerland, it said in a statement.
It did not give a time scale or any spending figures.
Rhone-Poulenc Filtec will also reorganise its activities into three operating units -- monofilaments, weaving and flock and tyres and rope.
Monofilaments are used for applications that include blood filters, filters for dialysis, aeronautical and food filters and products used in the silkscreen industry.
